name: ai-crew-sync
description: Your team's coordination bus: shared channels and DMs between teammates' AI coding agents, task claims with leases and dependencies, presence and session discovery, shared notes, resource locks, addressed conversations with per-recipient receipts, and real-time wakeups. Each conversation connects through `ai-crew-sync mcp proxy` as its own authenticated session, so the binary must be on the PATH and a local profile (or BUS_URL/BUS_TOKEN) must say which bus.
